description: A minimal search index over the v1 data layer. Generated at build time from the data files; consulted by the 404 page's search field. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §7.4 and §14.8. The index is small in v1 because the data layer is small. Each entry carries a stable route, a title, a short summary, and a kind discriminator.

entries.title: Prism Engine
entries.summary: Compile intelligence into something you can inspect. Prism is a constitutional ECS compiler and runtime for local, heterogeneous AI deployment.

entries.title: Start
entries.summary: A new visitor can understand Prism in five minutes without reading the README. The reading path starts with motivation and ends with the source.

entries.title: Architecture
entries.summary: Prism separates the decisions that model formats and runtimes usually blend together, then names each contract. LogicalTensor, PhysicalTileLayout, ExecutionView.

entries.title: ComputeImage
entries.summary: A ComputeImage is the boundary between compilation and execution, and it is inspectable. Six strata, three identities, the receipt.

entries.title: ComputeImage Specimen
entries.summary: A sanitized ComputeImage. The published bytes are a test fixture with LLaMA-shaped header and empty payloads. The redaction manifest is displayed.

entries.title: Evidence
entries.summary: An output is not authoritative because a backend returned it. Prism preserves the chain from accepted work to execution outcome. The v1 corpus is small; the gaps are named.

entries.title: Status
entries.summary: The authoritative answer to what exists, what qualifies, and what has been validated. The v1 status is small and honest.

entries.title: Run
entries.summary: The system that exists today can be built and run on Apple Silicon from the repository. The Packaged Path names its absence.

entries.title: Roadmap
entries.summary: Future milestones with explicit exit criteria. Ten milestones. The v1 release is milestone ten.

entries.title: The Life of a ComputeImage
entries.summary: The architecture as one experience. Twelve instruments, three densities, URL-addressable selection.

entries.title: PrismAgent
entries.summary: A private, local, conversational screen companion. Combines structured accessibility information with visual interpretation. Currently unreleased.

entries.title: Lab Notes
entries.summary: Some directions are research. They do not ship until they ship. Engram sidecars, KV-cache compaction, shadow calibration, adapter training.

entries.title: Colophon
entries.summary: Prism Engine is independently developed by Julian Torres. Five shapes of collaboration. The evidence class is recorded either way.

entries.title: ADR-032: Prism Observatory Deployment Platform (Cloudflare Pages)
entries.summary: Cloudflare Pages is the v1 publication layer. Real HTTP 301 redirects, real response headers, isolated previews, instant rollback.

entries.title: ADR-033: Schema Binding for Observatory v1 Evidence Artifacts
entries.summary: The §10 schema names are bound to engine types. Bindings 1, 2 are bound; bindings 3–7 are gaps closed by follow-on ADRs.

entries.title: ADR-034: Evidence Freeze for Observatory v1
entries.summary: One sanitized ComputeImage specimen. The other §10 slots are gap-flagged. The freeze is reopened when follow-on ADRs land.
